study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Nature Mental Health, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: A multimodal neural signature of face processing in autism within the fusiform gyrus

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) cohort. Data collected across six sites: King's College London (KCL), University of Cambridge (UCAM), Radboud University Nijmegen Medical Centre (RUNMC), University Medical Centre Utrecht (UMCU), Central Institute of Mental Health Mannheim (CIMH), and University Campus Bio-Medico Rome (UCBM).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Participants were part of the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort. They underwent comprehensive clinical, cognitive and MRI assessment at one of six collaborating sites."
